핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

글로벌 금리 상승 압력이 지속되는 가운데, 시장에서는 내년을 기점으로 주식에서 채권으로의 투자 관점 전환 가능성이 부각되고 있다. 반도체 공급 과잉 완화에 따른 '칩플레이션' 진정 기대감이 커지면서 채권 매력도가 높아지고 있으나, 델타 변수 등 불확실성이 여전히 채권 시장의 발목을 잡고 있다. 한편, 미국 주식 직접 투자(RIA)로 약 2조 원을 회수한 서학개미들이 미국 빅테크 차익 실현 후 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 등 국내 반도체주로 자금을 재배치하는 흐름도 포착된다. 거시적으로는 미국의 재정 적자 확대와 달러 패권 약화로 대표되는 글로벌 불균형 '시즌 2'가 전개되며 원화 및 신흥국 자산에 구조적 변동성을 높이고 있다. 결국 오늘의 시장은 **고금리 장기화 vs. 금리 정점 기대** 사이에서 자산 배분 전략을 재조정하는 과도기적 국면으로 읽힌다.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea faces mounting inflationary pressures as April producer prices surged 6.9% year-on-year and 2.5% month-on-month, reaching the highest monthly increase since the 1998 financial crisis. The spike is driven primarily by Middle East conflict-induced oil price increases, with petroleum products up 32% and semiconductors up 14%. Consumer price spillover effects are expected, prompting the government to extend fuel tax cuts and hold petroleum price ceilings. The Bank of Korea's May 28 rate decision is expected to maintain a hawkish hold rather than pursue preemptive rate cuts, reflecting both inflation and currency pressures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Producer price inflation reached 28-year highs in April as international crude prices surged due to Middle East tensions, creating immediate concerns about consumer price transmission and monetary policy pressures. Real unemployment rose to 6% on a provincial basis while the national rate climbed 0.1 percentage point year-on-year to 3.5%, suggesting labor market softening despite strong semiconductor export growth of 38%. The government has implemented countermeasures including extended fuel tax reductions, petroleum price freezes, and new price-gouging penalties to manage inflation. Currency depreciation pressures have intensified as the US-Korea interest rate differential widens, with the won facing additional upside pressure against the dollar.
sections.Financial Markets: US equity markets staged a rebound as Middle East peace negotiations reduced oil price pressures and eased rate hike expectations, though Fed officials remain hawkish on inflation concerns. The April FOMC minutes revealed multiple Fed officials view additional rate increases as necessary if inflation persists above target levels, signaling a more dovish pivot than expected but with conditions. The CME FedWatch tool shows a 51.1% probability of a December rate hike. Real interest rates have risen alongside nominal rates, creating dual selling pressure on both stocks and bonds, though foreign investors have rebalanced from KOSPI toward KOSDAQ, directing capital into robotics and technology stocks.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung Electronics averted a devastating strike after reaching a tentative wage agreement, alleviating critical AI semiconductor supply chain risks that could have impacted global technology sector operations.
